title: Internal Probe into PUB's Contract Irregularities Reported in AGO's FY2024/2025 Audit and Interim Governance Measures Implemented
what_it_is: Internal Probe into PUB's Contract Irregularities Reported in AGO's FY2024/2025 Audit and Interim Governance Measures Implemented

sections.label: Quotation authenticity concerns, Police report
sections.summary: AGO raised concerns over authenticity of quotations for 23 variation works worth $148,900, and PUB reported the matter to the Police.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: AGO raised concerns over the authenticity of quotations provided for 23 items of variation works, or star rate items, under a construction contract for waterscape works, which amounted to a total value of $148,900.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: PUB has reported the matter to the Police to investigate if there were any fraudulent practices involved.

sections.label: Biocide contract documentation falsification
sections.summary: PUB completed its internal investigation into documentation falsification for the biocide supply contract and found it was an individual officer's fault.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: As for the case of documentation falsification for the contract on supply of biocide, PUB has completed its internal investigation and found this to be the fault of an individual officer.

sections.label: Supply of stocks lapses
sections.summary: PUB identified root causes of supply of stocks lapses as officers not being diligent in checks and inadequate supervision, and disciplined six officers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On the lapses related to supply of stocks, PUB has identified the root causes to be individual officers not being diligent in carrying out the required checks and inadequate supervision to enforce the requirements stipulated under the contracts, including verification of documents submitted by the contractors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It has taken appropriate disciplinary action against the six officers involved.

sections.label: Human error and lack of integrity
sections.summary: One case was human error, while the other was more serious, a lack of integrity resulting in falsification of documents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Loh (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: One was human error, but the other one was more serious, which was a lack of integrity, resulting in the falsification of documents.

sections.label: Falsification as alteration
sections.summary: The other issue with falsification was actually an alteration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: The other issue with falsification, actually, it is an alteration.

sections.label: Reprimand, downgrade, contractor action
sections.summary: With no financial or operational suffering, reprimanding and downgrading his performance grade was decided, and action will follow if fraud intention is shown.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: There was not any suffering in terms of financial or operational issues that the agency has received.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: So, on that note, and in reviewing the guidelines and the regulations that the Public Service have adopted, we have decided that reprimanding and downgrading of his performance grade is the right outcome for him.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: There is no ground for us to doubt the integrity of parties that are involved, but should the outcome of the investigation show that there has been intention to defraud the agency, we will definitely do the appropriate action with regard to the contractor that is involved.
